articles.headline: The ARCA Menards Series silly season: who is going where in 2028
articles.dek: The offseason shuffling is complete as the garage prepares to drop the green flag on the 2028 campaign.
articles.body:
The garage doors are up and the preseason noise is finally settling across the ARCA Menards Series pit lane. While the points race has yet to officially kick off, the offseason departures have left massive shoes to fill for some of the series' heavy-hitting organizations.

Front Row Motorsports and Tricon Garage came calling during the winter months, poaching top tier talent straight out of the ARCA ranks. Valdemar Estriden packed his bags after leaving Pinnacle Racing Group, securing a massive promotion to the Craftsman Truck Series with Front Row Motorsports in the number 34 machine.

Not to be outdone, Samuel Riggs also made the jump to the Truck Series. Riggs vacated his ride at Nitro Motorsports to take over the wheel of the number 17 entry for Tricon Garage, leaving a pair of prime vacancies in the process.

Nitro Motorsports wasted no time filling those empty seats with fresh blood for the upcoming year. Twenty-one-year-old rookie Brady Hargrove steps into the number 15 machine, while seventeen-year-old Parker Teague takes over the number 25 entry.

These new pairings will define the early weeks of the schedule as the rookies get up to speed against the series veterans. With the grid nearly set, teams are finalizing their final paint schemes and crew chief pairings before everyone unloads for the season opener.
